before_snippet:
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image

arr = np.zeros((10, 10, 3), dtype=np.uint8)
# In 11.x, passing a mode that changes data type was deprecated but worked
img = Image.fromarray(arr, mode='RGB')
assert img.mode == 'RGB'
title: Image.fromarray no longer accepts mode argument for type-changing reinterpretation (only deprecated mode change)
